description: Novels, memoirs, non-fiction books, anthologies, and other long-form narrative works.

brief_fields.description: Core premise or log-line — one to two sentences summarising what the book is about.
Genre or sub-genre (e.g. literary fiction, memoir, thriller, cookbook).
Named principal characters with a one-sentence description each.
Central themes the work explores (e.g. identity, grief, redemption).
Approximate word-count target or chapter count.
Narrative point-of-view (first-person, third-person limited, omniscient, etc.).
